name: code
need: Show a block of code with its language, a copy button, line numbers, marked lines, files as tabs and a folded height

--ds-code-block-radius.description: `.ds-code-block`, a `pre` in prose and the `.ds-code` frame (times `--ds-shape`)

height..ds-code > .ds-code-block: a folded code block opens to its full height on --ds-ease-out (it pushes the content below, so it never overshoots), from the height it has, so a reversal continues
height..ds-code[data-state=\"collapsed\"] > .ds: a code block folds back to its lines on --ds-ease-in, 0.8 of the opening
